qti-item-body.p: A wetlands team measured dissolved oxygen, stream temperature, and visible algae after a summer storm. Which conclusion is best supported by the evidence?

qti-choice-interaction.qti-simple-choice: Runoff probably carried nutrients into the stream, because algae increased while dissolved oxygen fell.
The stream was unaffected by the storm, because the students visited the same site each day.
The warmer water caused the field notebooks to record more precise measurements.
The data show that all aquatic organisms left the stream immediately after the storm.
